intro: Trial at the Field of Giants is a warrior rites quest issued by Ruga Ragetotem at Camp Taurajo. As part of their training, martial aspirants are dispatched south into the swarming mounds of the Field of Giants to slay alien insectoid invaders. Candidates must harvest several still-twitching antennae and rush them back before the biological proof goes dormant.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To pass this trial, you must travel south to the Field of Giants. There you will find a host of crawling, insect creatures. They are new to the Barrens and I do not like what they herald.
Bring me their still-twitching antennae, and waste no time, friend, for harvested antennae will not twitch for long. Bring me the antennae in the time allowed, and you will pass the trial.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the antennae? If so then give them to me quickly, for twitching antennae do not twitch forever...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Nicely done, friend! In passing the trial at the Field of Giants, you take one more step down the adventurer's path.
